ValidationRule.description: The Contact Name is required for record type Global Service Case. The epic for reference #1008 added conditions related to self registration status #18954. #29931-Removed AccountId & SefRegistration
ValidationRule.errorConditionFormula: AND( $RecordType.DeveloperName = 'Global_Service_Case', ISPICKVAL(Status, 'Waiting for Agent'), NOT(ISPICKVAL(GSC_Sub_Category__c, 'Non Customer Complaint')), OR( AND( ISBLANK( ContactId ), Is_IM_Employee__c = False ), AND( ISBLANK(Customer_ID__c), ISBLANK(GSC_Billing_Account__c), ISBLANK(GSC_Operational_Account__c) ) ) )
ValidationRule.errorMessage: Contact Name and (Customer ID/Operational Account/Billing Account) are required.
